"""A module that writes journal lines directly — every write here must be reported."""

from django.db import connection

from numo9.ledger.models import JournalEntry, JournalLine


def sneaky(entry: JournalEntry, account: object) -> None:
    JournalLine(entry=entry, account=account, debit=1)  # 9: constructor
    JournalLine.objects.create(entry=entry, account=account, debit=1)  # 10
    JournalLine.objects.bulk_create([])  # 11
    JournalLine.objects.filter(entry=entry).update(debit=2)  # 12: queryset chain
    JournalLine._base_manager.filter(entry=entry).delete()  # 13
    with connection.cursor() as cursor:
        cursor.execute("UPDATE ledger_journalline SET debit = 0")  # 15
        cursor.execute("delete from ledger_journalline where id = %s", [1])  # 16


def reads_are_fine(entry: JournalEntry) -> object:
    total = JournalLine.objects.filter(entry=entry).count()
    rows = JournalLine.objects.filter(entry=entry).values_list("debit", flat=True)
    entry.lines.all()
    return total, list(rows), "SELECT * FROM ledger_journalline"
